notes: Word bank writing: pick how many at a time (5, 10, 15, 20 or all); ones you get wrong come back after the round. Single characters are asked with a clear meaning (west, not the West; abbr. for Spain) and a word that uses them (as in 东＿). Hint draws the next stroke in faint red. Your ink turns into the brush character stroke by stroke, starting the moment you tap Check. Right and wrong answers play the lesson sounds
